premises.text: The future of databases is distributed for scalability and reliability
premises.evidence_span: the future of databases is distributed. It's really the only way how you can build a scalable, reliable backend

premises.text: Building a distributed database requires combining multiple technologies
premises.evidence_span: you have to combine a lot of different technologies, like a relational DB. You have your unstructured data, so you add a document DB for your images and videos

premises.text: Scaling a database from millions to billions of records is complex
premises.evidence_span: scaling turns out to be more difficult than you thought, and replication issues keep you awake at night

premises.text: Crate provides real-time SQL in a distributed environment
premises.evidence_span: It gives you real-time SQL in a distributed environment

premises.text: Crate simplifies the installation and operation of distributed databases
premises.evidence_span: makes it extremely simple to install, run, and program

premises.text: Crate can self-heal when a node goes down
premises.evidence_span: Crate doesn't care. It detects a missing node, removes it from the cluster, and immediately starts a self-healing process

premises.text: Developers will face large amounts of data in the future
premises.evidence_span: all of the developers will be confronted with that amount of data

premises.text: Crate allows for installation on consumer-grade PCs
premises.evidence_span: you just install Crate on Promise. Or even on consumer-grade PCs, like this Intel Nux

value.text: Developers can build scalable backends easily with Crate
value.evidence_span: we're on a mission to bring distributed SQL backends in the hand of every developer
